question: Should this timing-dependent routed-binding abort race require live installed-binding proof, or may the deterministic regression plus QA pre-abort integration proof receive a maintainer override?
rationale: The remaining gap is evidence policy rather than a mechanical code repair: only a maintainer can decide whether controlled race coverage is sufficient for this route-and-binding behavior.

options.title: Require live routed-binding proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted installed-binding run shows cancellation during routed delivery suppresses the fallback path.

options.title: Approve a focused proof override
options.body: Accept the deterministic abort-race regression and QA propagation evidence as the strongest practical proof for an otherwise unobservable timing window.

recommendation.title: Require live routed-binding proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted installed-binding run shows cancellation during routed delivery suppresses the fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly asks this person to decide whether the remaining real-behavior proof gate can be overridden.
